verifiedBehavior: PHONE and EMAIL use repeatable controls; URL renders only safe http/https links; ADDRESS, WGS84 GEO and BARCODE use structured controls and canonical objects
IDENTITY and SECRET never prefill plaintext; SECRET detail exposes only set/unset state and replacement or clear actions

STATUS exposes only legal transition targets; BARCODE and STATUS are the only sortable P4-C2 fields

resolvedFindings.finding: The visible default CODE128 symbology was not emitted when a user entered only the barcode payload.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The structured model now writes CODE128 with the payload and the API/browser assertion verifies the canonical object.

resolvedFindings.finding: Two country-code inputs passed maxlength as a string and produced Vue prop warnings.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both controls bind numeric maxlength values; final journeys add no further prop warning.

resolvedFindings.finding: The mobile field selector could leave SECRET outside Ant Design's virtualized DOM.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The acceptance helper emits the holder scroll event and waits for the requested option, making the mobile journey repeatable.

resolvedFindings.finding: The test switched context while the platform page was still loading systems, producing a test-induced mounted-hook warning.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The login helper waits for platform loading to settle; the final restart run leaves the Vite error log unchanged.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial exact AJV dependency had a moderate advisory.
resolvedFindings.resolution: AJV is pinned to 8.20.0 and the final audit reports zero vulnerabilities.
